remarks_1999: Inscription fragment in Metropolitan Museum of Art files: "☆{5star}; An American Place2/An American Place9/Mr. Alfred Stieglitz/489 Park Ave"(GO, graphite). Metropolitan Museum of Art files indicate, "The artist says that *Corn Dark* was painted in 1924." Whitney Archive indicates, "July 1949: Miss Bry . . . told me that this picture is now on permanent loan to the Metropolitan Museum from Georgia O'Keeffe as part of that Alfred Stieglitz Coll." Either this or cat. no. 454 mentioned in 1934 New York (An American Place) exhibition review in *New York Times* (1934). Reproduced in *The Philadelphia Museum Bulletin* (June 1945). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as 'Oil on board'. The Met lists medium as 'Oil on wood fiberboard'. (Source: The Met, 2025)
